query: SELECT e.canonical_uri,e.source_id,s.introduced_by FROM discovery_entries e JOIN discovery_sources s ON s.id=e.source_id WHERE e.kind IN ('profile','community','video') AND (e.kind<>'community' OR $1) AND (e.kind<>'video' OR $2) AND e.state<>'withdrawn' AND s.enabled AND s.verified_at IS NOT NULL AND e.valid_until>clock_timestamp() AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_identity i WHERE i.canonical_uri=e.canonical_uri AND i.next_check_at<=clock_timestamp()) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_jobs j WHERE j.target_uri=e.canonical_uri AND j.operation='refresh_entry') ORDER BY NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM discovery_actor_labels l WHERE l.uri=e.canonical_uri) DESC,e.valid_until,e.id LIMIT 64
